0xe1c7392a.notice: Registers the adapter ERC-165 id. MUST be invoked via the diamond's `initialize` `_init` delegatecall.

natspec.notice: One-shot initializer for a `SuperchainETHBridge` interop adapter diamond — registers the {ISuperchainETHBridgeAdapter} ERC-165 id. There is nothing else to seed: the adapter is stateless (the predeploy is a compile-time constant), has no admin surface, and holds no funds. Delegatecalled by {Diamond.initialize} inside the initializing window (so it must NOT open its own pre/postInitializer).
